_comment: Pinned sample documents for the rhwp bump gate and CI engine smoke. Sourced from the upstream edwardkim/rhwp repository (MIT) test assets; sha256-pinned to raw URLs. Do not edit URLs without re-pinning checksums. Fetch with: standalone/scripts/rhwp-bump-gate.sh fetch <dir>

fixtures.name: plain-note.hwp
fixtures.why: Small text-only class: the canary for small-PDF threshold calibration (the v0.9.0 44KB->22.6KB incident class).

fixtures.name: law.hwp
fixtures.why: Dense legal text layout: catches line-breaking and justification regressions.

fixtures.name: columns.hwpx
fixtures.why: HWPX format + multi-column layout: covers the second input format and column pagination.

fixtures.name: standards.hwp
fixtures.why: Medium multi-page public regulatory document: exercises tables/sections at realistic size.
